name: Project Context: browse a repo doc, attach it to an agent, see it in a run's trace
description: AC-CTX-46. Needs the Project Context fixtures: SEED_CONTEXT_CLONE_PATH (set by scripts/e2e.sh and e2e-web.yml) points the seeded repo acme/payments-api at a fixture clone holding docs/spec.md (unique marker RULE-CTX-7f3a), and the seed adds one finished run for PR #482 whose trace read docs/spec.md. Part 1: the Context page shows the roots, the docs/spec.md entry and a read-only preview. Part 2: attach docs/spec.md to the first agent, see it listed (its Detach button exists), then detach it again so the DB is left as seeded. Part 3: PR #482 > Agent runs > open the seeded run's trace; the drawer lists docs/spec.md and the Project context section shows the placeholder line, not the doc text. No review is started, nothing is imported and no LLM is called. The flow runner has no negative assertion, so 'the marker is absent from the trace' is not asserted here: the seeded trace holds no marker by construction (server/src/db/seed.ts) and the real executor path is covered by server/test/run-executor-context.test.ts and context.it.test.ts.
